state.previous_paragraph: Later on October 11, 2013, the two members of the Transaction Committee telephoned CSC/Pamplona and communicated the Special Committee's position. Shortly following that conversation, the representative of CSC/Pamplona telephoned Mr. Daoust and agreed to the $11 million Mac-Gray
state.paragraph: termination fee. Following such agreement, Goodwin Procter delivered Kirkland revised drafts of the merger agreement and the Pamplona commitment letter.
